exposure: in-hospital placement of intrauterine devices and contraceptive implants
immediate postpartum copper T380 intrauterine devices
cohort: Women presenting to the University of Utah labor and delivery unit from October 2013 through February 2016 who requested an intrauterine device or implant for postpartum contraception
finding: Immediate postplacental levonorgestrel intrauterine device users have higher expulsion rates than copper intrauterine device users, but the 6-month continuation rate was high (≥80%) for all device types.
mod_finding: There was no statistically significant difference in expulsions by delivery type.
